body.x: Otiton Medical, led by CEO Kim Jaeyoung, drew global attention at CES 2025 in Las Vegas with its innovative smart thermometer and telemedicine platform, “Dr. In Home.”

The award-winning Dr. In Home integrates temperature measurement with telemedicine capabilities, offering a groundbreaking solution to improve healthcare accessibility. This device measures body temperature and captures high-definition images of the ears, nose, and throat, transmitting the data to a mobile app for real-time remote consultations with physicians.
Equipped with a high-resolution camera, Dr. In Home allows parents to monitor their child’s health and easily diagnose conditions such as otitis media, sinusitis, and tonsillitis from home.

body.cap: The Dr. In Home smart thermometer enables body temperature measurement and imaging of the ears, nose, and throat. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The platform facilitates instant telemedicine consultations through its seamless connection to healthcare professionals. CEO Kim Jaeyoung explained, “Dr. In Home was developed to help families maintain their health in environments with limited medical access.” He cited his experiences in Vietnam during the COVID-19 pandemic as the inspiration behind the product’s development.

Otiton Medical’s participation in CES 2025 and its recognition as an Innovation Award Honoree reaffirm its technological capabilities and market potential. The company has previously garnered attention at international exhibitions in Japan, the U.S., and Silicon Valley, further solidifying its global presence. It was also selected for Japan’s startup program, accelerating its international expansion.

Kim expressed confidence in the product’s future: “Winning the CES Innovation Award and participating in the exhibition validate our technology and market differentiation. This milestone will help us grow into a global brand.”

Looking ahead, Otiton Medical is expanding its offerings to include pet health management solutions. The upcoming “Dr. Pet Care,” set for release next year, will help diagnose ear conditions in dogs and cats at home.

The company’s vision extends beyond a simple thermometer to providing professional diagnostic capabilities and secure telemedicine connections from the comfort of home. Kim emphasized, “Dr. In Home is designed to help parents confidently care for their children and aims to usher in a new paradigm for telemedicine.”

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
